title: docs(adr): ADR-0136 declared journeys as the priority anchor
body:
Fixes #18477

Maintainer 「立」 (2026-09-16, direct channel). **Rework round (2026-09-16):** the maintainer requested changes on the first draft (review 5224841038, verbatim: 「这是云服务的旅程，不是本应用开发平台的旅程。本平台的目的是不能让第三方开发者能进入我们的元数据协议快速地开发迭代企业管理应用。」). The journey table is now the **developer platform's** journeys; the cloud-service rows moved to a 「未入选 — cloud 服务自己的清单」 subsection. One new ADR and one pointer line; nothing else touched.

## What this PR does

- Adds `docs/adr/0136-declared-journeys-as-priority-anchor.md` — the maintainer's priority law: a journey table drafted from EXISTING sources only, the three rulings phrased as rules the PM protocol will cite, and one line superseding `docs/adr/PRIORITIZATION.md` as the priority anchor.
- Adds ONE line at the top of `docs/adr/PRIORITIZATION.md` pointing at ADR-0136 (that file is otherwise untouched; it keeps its method and the status-hygiene rule).
- `SKILL.md` is NOT edited — the enforcement is a separate skills-lane card filed after acceptance, as the card rules.

## The table, by the numbers (rework)

- **10 rows** (the cap). **9 rows have a runner**, **1 is `none yet`** (J9: a customer requirement landing end-to-end in the reference third-party app — hotcrm `ci.yml` + `e2e.yml` prove the app still boots and hooks fire after an iteration, not that a REQ landed).
- The anchor is the third-party developer, end to end: J1 discover + scaffold (getting-started → `npm create objectstack` → 10 skills → health) · J2 author metadata by hand (objects / fields / views / flows / permissions, every kind honoured at runtime) · J3 AI-assisted authoring (Claude Code + skills, or a prompt to the build agent) · J4 Studio zero-code loop · J5 `os dev` and see it in the console (objectui is the rendering half, inside this row) · J6 verify (`os validate` / `os lint` / `objectstack verify`; traps refused loudly) · J7 package + publish · J8 install into an environment · J9 iterate against a customer requirement (hotcrm `docs/requirements/` + `.github/tasks/new-feature.md`) · J10 the app's end users as the closing proof (CRUD, RLS, FLS) — one row, not the anchor.
- **Moved to 未入选 — cloud 服务自己的清单** (6 lines): new-user signup → org → environment (cloud#1653); control-plane launch speed (cloud#1521); hosted HotCRM login / per-org space / tenant isolation (cloud ADR-0111 R1–R3); operator service enablement + blast radius (R4, R6.1); billing posture (ADR-0111 D1 attachment point); cloud-side review + counter-sign of a published package (LOCAL-E2E D5–D6). The ADR says the cloud repo may declare its own list in the same shape.
- **未入选 — 平台侧** (2 lines): the approvals-inbox entry (`approvals.account-app-entry`, end-user face) and the custom-page items (folded into J2 / J4).
- Every runner cited exists on its tree (checked with `git cat-file -e` on `origin/main` of each repo). Readings are dated 2026-09-16 snapshots; the ADR says so and names where the live data lives.

### Sources and their row counts before reduction

| source (all on `origin/main`) | rows before | reduced to |
|---|---|---|
| objectstack `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` (`areas/*.json`, `coverage.json`) | 264 items / 15 areas / 19 P0 | 22 items across J1–J10 · 3 more in 未入选 |
| objectstack `content/docs/getting-started/` (`meta.json`) | 8 pages | J1, J3 |
| objectstack `skills/objectstack-*` (+ `skills/README.md`) | 10 skills | J1, J2, J3 |
| objectstack `packages/create-objectstack/README.md` · `packages/cli/README.md` · `packages/verify/README.md` · `packages/mcp/README.md` | 1 template · the command tables · 2 proof families · the MCP surface | J1 · J5, J6, J7 · J6, J10 · J3 |
| hotcrm `docs/requirements/README.md` + REQ-0001–0006 · `.github/tasks/new-feature.md` · `publish-*.yml`, `ci.yml`, `e2e.yml` | 6 records + 1 task flow + 4 workflows | J6, J7, J9 |
| cloud `scripts/dev-local/MAGIC-FLOW-TEST-RUNBOOK.md` §7 | 8 checkpoints | runner for J3 only (as the ruling allows) |
| first-draft cloud sources: cloud ADR-0111 (17 acceptance rows) · cloud#1521 · cloud#1653 · `LOCAL-E2E-CHECKLIST.md` A / D | 17 + 6 + 1 + 9 | moved out → 6 未入选 lines |

## Deviations, declared

1. The maintainer's sentence is quoted verbatim including 「不能让」; the ADR notes the director's reading (「能让」) beside it and states the direction is the same either way.
2. Readings for J1, J2, J3, J6, J7, J10 come from read-only REST reads of Actions runs / check-runs on 2026-09-16 (scaffold-e2e run 3082, check-links run 9879, Dogfood Regression Gate on `main@85c6d76e`, cloud golden-journey run 17, hotcrm ci run 3054 / e2e run 1272 / publish-staging run 11 / publish-production run 5) — not from the named documents, which carry no reading for those rows.
3. `origin/main` moved during the round; merged with `bash scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (merge commit `082b9e37`, nothing to regenerate — the branch touches only `docs/adr/`). Three-dot diff vs `origin/main` is still exactly the two files (+114 lines).

## Gates (exit codes captured before any pipe; tree `365d1bc0`)

Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack docs/adr/0136-declared-journeys-as-priority-anchor.md docs/adr/PRIORITIZATION.md` (18 commands, identical to round 1), re-derived from the merge base after the commit and reconciled: `dispatch-gates --ran: 18 derived, 18 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 18 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

- `check-adr-links` :: 0 · `--self-test` :: 0 · `check-adr-symbol-anchors` :: 0 · `--self-test` :: 0 · `pnpm check:adr-anchors` :: 0
- `check:doc-authoring` :: 0 · `check:nul-bytes` :: 0 · `check:pm-governed-merges` :: 0 · `check:pm-prior-rulings` :: 0 · `check:driver-memory-census` :: 0 · `check:refd-timer-probe` :: 0 · `check:watch-hint-literal` :: 0
- `check-ci-filter-parity` :: 0 · `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`) :: 0 · `check-comment-mask-corpus` :: 0 · `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` :: 0 (formula + lint built under the verify lock first, as in round 1)
- `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` :: **1** — NOT caused by this diff. The gate names `packages/cli/test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts` walking into `packages/spec/dist/`, a directory that exists in this worktree only because the lock-wrapped formula/lint build built `@objectstack/spec` as a dependency. Same code, dist absent (round 1, before that build) → exit 0; dist present → exit 1, stable on re-run. `origin/main` tip `9c1897e5` shows `Lint & Repo Gates` success at 2026-09-16T15:25Z on the same gate. Reported in the os-dev-report as an out-of-scope finding for the seat to file (build-state-dependent gate verdict); this PR touches no test, no `turbo.json`, no package.

No package is touched, so no ① dependency-closure build and no ② package test/typecheck are owed. Repo-wide scans are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed (round 1, still true): the card names cloud ADR-0111 acceptance rows 1.1–5.x; the file on cloud `origin/main` (`7be90d0`) also carries R6 (6.1–6.2), so the honest count is 17, not 15. 承接者: the maintainer editing the table.
- `skip-changeset`: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing (fast lane).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 重写了 `docs/adr/0136` 的 D1:旅程表现在是**开发者平台的旅程**,主角是第三方开发者——J1 发现协议并脚手架 → J2 手写元数据 → J3 AI 辅助写元数据 → J4 Studio 零代码 → J5 `os dev` 在控制台看到 → J6 验证(错拼与退役键响亮拒收)→ J7 打包发布 → J8 装进环境 → J9 对着客户需求迭代(hotcrm 的 REQ 线是参考第三方应用)→ J10 终端用户增删改查 + 权限,作为「做出来的应用能用」的证明。10 行到上限,9 行有 runner,1 行 `none yet`(J9)。**移到「未入选 — cloud 服务自己的清单」**:新用户注册建组织建环境(cloud#1653)、控制面发布速度(cloud#1521)、托管 HotCRM 登录 / 建空间 / 租户隔离(cloud ADR-0111 R1–R3)、运营者启停 Service 与爆炸半径、计费姿态、云端审核副签。D2 三条裁决、D3 取代 `PRIORITIZATION.md`、Consequences 不变,只把源与归并账目换成新表。`PRIORITIZATION.md` 仍只多一行指针。

**为什么改。** 你的驳回:「这是云服务的旅程,不是本应用开发平台的旅程。本平台的目的是不能让第三方开发者能进入我们的元数据协议快速地开发迭代企业管理应用。」首稿把云服务的路当成了锚;本仓是应用开发平台,锚应当是第三方开发者进入元数据协议、快速开发并迭代企业管理应用的路。每一行仍只取自树上已有文件(平台清单 264 项、getting-started 8 页、10 个技能、create-objectstack、cli / verify / mcp 的 README、hotcrm 的需求记录与任务流),⛔ 没有发明任何一行;cloud 的 runbook 只留作 J3「AI 从提示词建应用」的 runner。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 这是法不是执法:`SKILL.md` 未动。云服务的路不在表里不等于不重要,ADR 写明 cloud 仓可按同一形状自立清单。读数是当天快照,会腐烂。本地门禁有一项红(`check:cross-package-test-inputs`),是本 worktree 里 `packages/spec/dist/` 被构建出来后一条既有 cli 测试的走盘范围没被声明,与本 diff 无关,`main` 同门禁绿;已作为待立卡发现交席位。回滚 = 删掉 `0136` 文件并去掉 `PRIORITIZATION.md` 第 2 行,没有代码依赖它。

**席位意见。** (留空,席位定稿成评论)

**你要做的。** 再读一遍这张表,**按删除与替换编辑**:十行是不是你要开发者走的十段路;J9 的 runner 要么你给要么删;「未入选 — cloud」六行是不是你要的处置(留在 cloud 仓自立清单);确认 D2 三条的措辞就是你要 PM 协议引用的措辞;然后手动合并(governed surface,PR 保持 draft,席位不翻 ready)。
